meta.description: State-wise landed grid electricity tariff in rupees per kWh, covering energy charge, demand or fixed charge spread over units, fuel adjustment, electricity duty and surcharges. Commercial or HT categories only: domestic rates are deliberately excluded. Seeded from open and secondary data; the source of truth is each State Electricity Regulatory Commission's annual tariff order. Refresh annually.

rows.note: The brief's working default from search snippets giving 8.20 to 10.20 rupees per kWh in data-centre clusters. Not verified against any tariff order. Used for any state without a verified row.
